name: Thematic
summary: Customer-feedback analytics platform (Thematic): its llms.txt calls it "the customer intelligence layer for enterprise CX", and it also sells a Voice of Employee solution. A first-party MCP at regional endpoints (US https://mcp.client.getthematic.com) lets a connected AI query vendor-computed themes, comments and counts under the user's own login; a keyless initialize returned 401 Bearer on 2026-11-17. Read-only Analysis tools include get_themes, get_comments and get_row_count; the composition is Thematic's, not the model's, so it claims hr.summarize-engagement-feedback. Unmeasured.

payments.notes: Pricing page (200, 2026-11-17): Foundation "$25,000 / year" for "up to 25,000 comments a year across 3 datasets"; Enterprise custom. Page silent on mechanism; Terms of Service §1 authorizes charging the "credit card or other form of payment held on file" -> card-on-file. Not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless. Fixed public regional endpoints (US https://mcp.client.getthematic.com; ANZ/EU variants). A keyless POST initialize returned HTTP 401 Bearer with resource_metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource on 2026-11-17; /mcp is 404, server at root. Sign-in is the user's Thematic login.

jobs.summary: Analysis MCP tools return vendor-computed themes, verbatim comments and counts: get_themes (volume/sentiment/score effect), get_comments, get_row_count. Thematic sells this for employee surveys ("Scale Employee Listening"). Vendor docs, not measured; accuracy and time-to-report unmeasured.
